description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) MERCY IS WEAKNESS (Ironclad Champions, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). The fight list's real click selects the Redemptor Dreadnought (DREADNOUGHT, engaged with the Meganobz); unit_selected_to_fight opens; the card offers the printed choice — one button per option ([LETHAL HITS] / Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]); a real click on the [LETHAL HITS] button spends 1 CP; the Redemptor's attacks have [LETHAL HITS] and not [SUSTAINED HITS].
